name: Goat Hill Mansion
source:
A lone figure wanders amongst the misty marshes with a longing. 

A young woman is looking for a fresh start.

[From [url=https://phantom-eye.itch.io/goat-hill-mansion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一道孤寂的身影怀揣着渴望，在迷雾缭绕的沼泽间徘徊。

一名年轻女子正寻觅着重新开始的契机。

[摘自[url=https://phantom-eye.itch.io/goat-hill-mansion]itch.io[/url]]
